title: Inconsistency of the results of the round function

comments.text:
Description:
We found inconsistencies when we used the round function to preserve decimals on integers. We are not sure whether this is a bug.

How to repeat:
We found problems in the following test cases
select round(1,2); --expected:1.00   --actual:1

Suggested fix:
We can't find the relevant description in the document. We think that this inconsistency is not consistent with the expected result. Maybe we need to modify the calculation of the round function for int-type data

Hello Chenglin Tian,

Thank you for the report.

regards,
Umesh

Posted by developer:
 
This is not a bug.

When ROUND is called for an integer argument, the result is also an integer.

This is documented in the manual as follows:

The return value has the same type as the first argument (assuming that it is integer, double, or decimal). This means that for an integer argument, the result is an integer (no decimal places):
